title: Symplectic GL_K(F_2) Stabilizer Tableau Witness Compiler
claims: Any reversible CNOT network |x> -> |W x mod 2> induces the 2K x 2K symplectic tableau S_W = diag(W, (W^{-1})^T) preserving S_W^T Omega S_W == Omega (mod 2).

Placing m linearly independent mod-2 kernel witnesses in the first m columns of W^{-1} compiles a unified CNOT circuit whose anchor-zero branch extracts all m even-sublattice columns A v_j in (2*Z_q)^n.
